1_executive_technology_brief.what_it_does: A control system that predicts impending shunt catheter obstruction from flow/pressure trends and pre-emptively redistributes drainage to healthy segments while maintaining global ICP and preventing overload of surviving paths.
1_executive_technology_brief.why_it_matters: Catheter obstruction causes 30-50% of shunt failures. Current shunts are reactive — they fail, then the patient needs emergency surgery. This system predicts failure hours to days ahead and prevents it.
1_executive_technology_brief.technical_differentiator: Dual safety invariant: (1) global ICP maintained within target band, AND (2) no surviving drainage path overloaded. Both must hold simultaneously. This is a control law, not a device architecture.
1_executive_technology_brief.revised_claim_R277: SIMULATOR FALSIFIED the strict dual-invariant claim AND the implied 24h survival claim. Strict INV-1 (P_ICP<=20) FAILS at peak ~22 mmHg under multi-segment progressive failure. The system ALSO fails the 24h survival criterion (breaks at ~14h when ICP has been out-of-band >1 hour cumulative) — in BOTH multi-segment AND single-segment baseline. HONEST claim is PARTIAL IMPROVEMENT: multi-segment peaks at 22 mmHg vs 59 mmHg baseline (lower peak = less acute harm), INV-2 (no path overload) preserved 5/5 (real safety win), but system does NOT solve the underlying problem — both designs break at ~14h. See P-01_PROTOTYPE/05_simulator.py for falsification evidence.
1_executive_technology_brief.self_correction_log_R277: Initial R277 audit overclaimed 'graceful degradation, survival 5/5'. Re-analysis of actual simulator JSON data showed survival=0/5 across ALL scenarios. Corrected in this revision per Article XXXI. The honest finding is more severe than initially documented.

2_mechanism_dossier.causal_chain: Flow/pressure trends → Bayesian occlusion probability estimate → pre-emptive flow redistribution → global ICP stability + path overload prevention

operating_states.normal: All segments healthy. Flow distributed normally.
operating_states.warning: One or more segments show elevated occlusion probability (>threshold). Flow proactively reduced on at-risk segments, redistributed to healthy segments.
operating_states.isolation: Segment occlusion probability exceeds critical threshold. Segment isolated. All flow redistributed to healthy segments respecting dual invariant.
operating_states.graceful_degradation: Multi-segment failure exceeds design capacity. INV-2 preserved (no path overload). INV-1 violated (P_ICP 20-25 mmHg). System continues operating for several hours but does NOT meet 24h survival — breaks at ~14h.
operating_states.fail_safe: Complete controller failure. Reverts to passive pressure-reactive drainage (standard shunt behavior).
operating_states.recovery: Isolated segment recovered (flow restored). System returns to normal.

2_mechanism_dossier.physics_basis: Hydraulic flow distribution in a multi-segment drainage network with variable conductance. P_ICP = Q_production / sum(G_active). Occlusion modeled as conductance decline over time. See P-01_PROTOTYPE/01_hydraulic_architecture.json for full physics model.

Communication between segments (if distributed) or central processing (if integrated)

4_engineering_specification.sensors: Pressure sensors (0-50 mmHg range, ±0.5 mmHg accuracy). Flow sensors (0-1 mL/min range, ±0.05 mL/min accuracy). Status: EXTERNAL_SOURCE (sensors exist commercially). See P-01_PROTOTYPE/03_sensor_specification.json.
4_engineering_specification.actuators: Variable orifice mechanisms per segment (0-100% open). Response time <1 second. Status: HYPOTHESIS (miniaturized variable orifice for chronic implantation needs development). See P-01_PROTOTYPE/02_component_specification.json.
4_engineering_specification.electronics: Ultra-low-power microcontroller (ARM Cortex-M0+ class, <1mW). Status: EXTERNAL_SOURCE.
4_engineering_specification.software: Bayesian occlusion prediction model. Proportional+INV-2-cap flow redistribution. Status: MODELLED (algorithm designed, Python reference implementation complete, C port required for implantable). See P-01_PROTOTYPE/04_control_algorithm.json.
4_engineering_specification.operating_envelope: ICP 5-40 mmHg. Flow 0.1-0.5 mL/min per segment. CSF temperature 37°C. Chronic implantation (>5 years).

5_prototype_blueprint.v0_bench_prototype: Acrylic manifold + 4x COTS flow sensors + 4x COTS pinch valves + 1x COTS pressure sensor + peristaltic pump + Arduino/RPi controller running Python reference impl. Total cost ~$3-5K, build time 3-6 months. See P-01_PROTOTYPE/06_bench_prototype_design.json.
5_prototype_blueprint.v1_implantable_prototype: MEMS variable-orifice valves + Codman MicroSensor + custom implantable flow sensor (NO COMMERCIAL OPTION — biggest engineering risk) + hermetic electronics + Saft LM-175 cell + MICS RF telemetry. Estimated $200-500K, 12-18 months.
5_prototype_blueprint.blocking_unknown: No chronic implantable CSF flow sensor exists commercially. Options: (a) custom ultrasonic, (b) infer from pressure drop, (c) eliminate per-segment flow sensing.
5_prototype_blueprint.what_to_build_first: V0 bench prototype. Reproduce simulator findings on hardware. Then decide on V1 implantable path.
5_prototype_blueprint.estimated_build_time: 3-6 months V0 bench. 12-18 months V1 implantable. 24-48 months pre-clinical. 24-48 months clinical. 12-24 months PMA. Total: 5-10 years to market.

6_reference_implementation.simulation_code: P-01_PROTOTYPE/05_simulator.py — Python, ~650 lines, no external dependencies.
6_reference_implementation.model_parameters: 4 segments, Q_production=0.30 mL/min, P_TARGET=12 mmHg, P_MIN=5, P_MAX=20, F_MAX=0.30 mL/min per segment, k_occl=1/hr, lesion onset 2-18h, 5 scenarios × 5 seeds = 25 runs.
6_reference_implementation.falsification_finding: STRICT dual-invariant FAILS at peak ~22 mmHg. PARTIAL IMPROVEMENT confirmed: multi-segment peaks at 22 mmHg (vs 59 baseline), INV-2 holds 5/5 (vs 5/5 baseline — both hold, but multi-segment has 4 paths at 22 vs 1 path at 59). NEITHER system meets 24h survival — both break at ~14h when ICP has been out of band >1 hour cumulative. SELF-CORRECTION: initial R277 audit overclaimed 'survival 5/5'; corrected after re-analyzing actual JSON data (Article XXXI).
6_reference_implementation.next_iteration_needed: Increase F_MAX_PER_SEG OR n_segments OR add accumulator buffer to push conflict boundary below P_MAX.

7_experimental_protocol.test_1_bench_validation: V0 bench prototype. 6 scenarios × 5 seeds = 30 runs, 24 hours each, 720 bench-hours total. See P-01_PROTOTYPE/EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF/frozen_protocol.json.
7_experimental_protocol.test_2_misspecification: Run with incorrect occlusion model (wrong decay rate). Does graceful degradation still hold? Does the system fail safely?
7_experimental_protocol.test_3_strongest_baseline: Compare against single-segment standard of care. Simulator predicts 59 mmHg peak (baseline) vs 22 mmHg peak (P-01).
7_experimental_protocol.test_4_chronic_feasibility: Material biocompatibility, sensor drift, actuator fatigue over simulated 5-year operation.
7_experimental_protocol.test_5_hostile_matrix: INV-2 attacker (fast lesion), INV-1 attacker (slow all-segment), predictor false-positive (noise spikes), predictor false-negative (very slow lesion), communication failure. See P-01_PROTOTYPE/07_test_fixtures.json.

13_safety_package.failure_modes: Algorithm failure (graceful degradation to passive drainage). Actuator failure (fail-open or fail-closed per segment, detect and isolate). Sensor failure (use redundant sensors or fall back to pressure-only mode).
